the_subtlety: this producer is a SERVER the supervisor stops on purpose, and subprocess reports a signal death as a NEGATIVE return code. A healthy teardown is -15, not 0, so requiring a literal zero would refuse every good acquisition. The supervisor DECLARES the signal it sent; the reader is not taught to forgive negative codes generally, and the raw value is retained -- root warned against normalizing the process to manufacture agreement.
